faq.q: What is the origin of Abdelrahman?
faq.a: Abdelrahman is associated with Arabic. Abdelrahman is Arabic عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَن (ʿAbd al-Raḥmān), meaning 'servant of the Most Merciful'.
Yes — the underlying form عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَن is Arabic.
